description: Provider configuration corpus for `integration.providers`. Each case is raw configuration text plus the verdict GTA-Claw must reach. `expect` is either `accepted`, `rejected_by_parser` when strict deserialisation must refuse the text before any registry lookup happens, or the stable `ConfigError::code`/`AuthError::code` the resolver must return. Codes are compared rather than rendered messages, so wording may be improved without editing this corpus.

cases.name: a-misspelt-key-is-refused-rather-than-defaulted
cases.why: the field is spelt base-url; an ignored base_url would silently call the default endpoint

cases.name: an-invented-key-is-refused
cases.why: a key the schema does not have must not be accepted and dropped

cases.name: a-missing-identifier-is-refused
cases.why: there is no default provider

cases.name: a-missing-credential-block-is-refused
cases.why: even a credential-free provider states mode=none explicitly, so a forgotten credential is never mistaken for a deliberate one

cases.name: a-wrongly-typed-value-is-refused
cases.why: a truthy string is not a boolean

cases.name: an-unknown-credential-mode-is-refused
cases.why: the credential tag is closed over the eight known auth modes

cases.name: a-credential-field-from-another-mode-is-refused
cases.why: mixing shapes hides which field is actually used

cases.name: a-credential-attached-to-mode-none-is-refused
cases.why: an operator who wrote a token must not be left believing it is in force

cases.name: an-unregistered-identifier-is-refused
cases.why: the frozen inventory is the whole set of providers

cases.name: a-frozen-identifier-with-a-fold-applied-is-not-a-provider
cases.why: separator folding is not performed, because it would merge novita-ai with novitaai and gmi-cloud with gmicloud

cases.name: a-registration-only-provider-cannot-be-configured
cases.why: no Bedrock client ships, and a configuration that appears to work would be a lie

cases.name: a-registration-only-media-provider-cannot-be-configured
cases.why: fal.ai is media generation, not a chat dialect this crate implements

cases.name: an-endpoint-required-provider-without-an-endpoint-is-refused
cases.why: GTA-Claw ships no verified endpoint for this identifier and must not invent one

cases.name: an-unparsable-endpoint-is-refused
cases.why: a relative URL has no origin to bind a credential to

cases.name: a-plaintext-remote-endpoint-is-refused
cases.why: a bearer token must not cross a plaintext link to a remote host

cases.name: a-non-http-endpoint-is-refused
cases.why: only https, or http on loopback, is an endpoint

cases.name: a-configured-authorization-header-is-refused
cases.why: a configured credential header would race the one the client attaches

cases.name: a-configured-api-key-header-is-refused-whatever-its-case
cases.why: HTTP field names are case-insensitive, so the check must be too

cases.name: a-credential-mode-the-provider-does-not-accept-is-refused
cases.why: openai authenticates with a bearer token, and a key sent the wrong way is a leak with no benefit

cases.name: a-credential-handed-to-a-credential-free-runtime-is-refused
cases.why: a local runtime accepts only mode=none, so a token here was meant for something else

cases.name: an-empty-credential-is-refused
cases.why: an unset environment variable expands to an empty string

cases.name: a-whitespace-credential-is-refused
cases.why: a whitespace-only secret is no secret, and failing locally beats failing at the vendor
